headline: Goldman Sachs and Citi Project China Housing Market Recovery by 2027
summary: Goldman Sachs and Citi anticipate a stabilization and potential turning point in China's housing market by 2027, citing contracting supply and resilient sales figures in major cities during early October.
why: China's real estate downturn has constrained domestic economic growth and commodity demand for half a decade; a bottoming out would provide major macro relief.

impacts.name: China Real Estate
impacts.why: Long-term stabilization projections encourage investment banks to reconsider exposure to Chinese property equities.
